snippet.title: BLOOD MALL: PART II | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist BLOOD MALL: PART II now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177120

Join r/bloodmall! https://www.reddit.com/r/bloodmall

All my links: https://linktr.ee/olliehallgames

------------

The mall was only the beginning. 
BLOOD MALL: PART II is a retro-style dinosaur horror game that picks up exactly where BLOOD MALL left off. Are you prepared to put an end to the Hastovenator Crisis, or have you bitten off more than you can chew?
